title: boAt Bassheads 102 in-Ear Wired Earphones with Mic
description: boAt Bassheads 102 wired earphones deliver powerful bass with an in-line mic and remote control for hands-free calls. Lightweight in-ear design with silicone ear tips for a snug fit.

reviews.author: Rahul S.
reviews.title: Amazing bass quality
reviews.body: Best earphones under 500 rupees. Bass is deep and mic works perfectly for calls.

reviews.author: Priya K.
reviews.title: Good value
reviews.body: Build quality is decent for the price. Sound is clear and fits well.

reviews.author: Amit R.
reviews.title: Average durability
reviews.body: Sounds great initially but cable felt a bit thin after a month.
